channel.title: The Grant Desk - Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, EU, weekly digest
channel.description: Paid open calls, fellowships and residencies in AI, tech, research, and digital and mixed-media arts, sorted into the right pile. Updated as new calls land on the desk. Filtered to: Artist Residencies, Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact, EU, weekly digest. Released weekly: the week's new grants arrive together on Sunday, one entry per grant plus a short roundup header, instead of trickling out daily.

item.title: 3 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies - week of 24 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Archipel Butor Livre de dialogue Creation Residency 2027
    https://www.archipel-butor.fr/residence-creation/
    Archipel Butor · deadline Closed 30 Aug 2026 · Creation grant of EUR 2,000 gross per month per artist, so roughly EUR 4,000 each across the two months and EUR 8,000 for the pair. Up to two return journeys per person are covered within France and Europe. Accommodation is provided in Michel Butor's writer's house. No application fee.
  • Ars Biologica ArtXScience Residency 2027-2028 (Ars Electronica x Ceske Budejovice ECoC 2028)
    https://ars.electronica.art/export/en/ecoc2028-ars-biologica-art-science-residency/
    Ars Electronica and Ceske Budejovice - European Capital of Culture 2028 · deadline 28 Sep 2026 · EUR 24,000 total package per winner: EUR 6,000 artist fee, up to EUR 15,000 production budget, and up to EUR 3,000 for travel, accommodation and subsistence, plus a separate budget covering one month of housing in Ceske Budejovice. Two positions available. Free to apply.
  • Stimuleringsfonds: Open Call Residency Videotage 2027 (Hong Kong)
    https://www.stimuleringsfonds.nl/en/grants/open-call-videotage
    Stimuleringsfonds Creatieve Industrie (Creative Industries Fund NL) in collaboration with Videotage, Hong Kong · deadline 21 Oct 2026 · EUR 5,000 for a two-month residency or EUR 6,500 for a three-month residency, paid by the Creative Industries Fund NL to cover travel, insurance, living expenses, compensation for time invested, and material and transport costs. Accommodation, use of the studio space and facilitation by Videotage are covered directly by the Fund on top of this. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 2 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies - week of 17 Aug 2026
item.description:
• Studio ALTA Residence 2027: four residency open calls (Prague)
    https://www.altart.cz/rezidence-2027/
    Studio ALTA · deadline 10 Sep 2026 · Residency fees paid to participants: Research House CZK 12,000 per project; Rest House CZK 6,000 per person; House in the Neighborhood CZK 30,000 per project; House of Sweat CZK 15,000 per project. All include workspace at Studio ALTA; the two production residencies add dramaturgic, production, technical and PR support. Free to apply.
  • Martin Roth-Initiative: Temporary Relocation for Artists and Cultural Actors at Risk (Programme Line 1, 2026 call)
    https://www.martin-roth-initiative.de/en/application-programme-line-1
    Martin Roth-Initiative (Goethe-Institut and ifa, funded by the German Federal Foreign Office) · deadline 11 Sep 2026 · Monthly scholarship for the relocated artist, plus insurance, language courses, psychosocial support, counselling and training, visa support, and personnel funding for the host organisation. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies - week of 10 Aug 2026
item.description:
• transmediale x Pro Helvetia Digital Art Residency 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/digital-art-residency-2027
    transmediale (in cooperation with the Swiss Arts Council Pro Helvetia) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Artist fee of CHF 2,000 per month across the two-month residency (CHF 4,000), plus a production grant of CHF 15,000 for the selected project, plus travel and accommodation for both the festival and the residency month. Duos and collectives may apply but the fee and the production grant stay the same and must be shared. No application fee.
  • Vilem Flusser Residency for Artistic Research 2027
    https://transmediale.de/en/news/vilem-flusser-residency-for-artistic-research-2027
    transmediale and the Vilem Flusser Archive, Universitat der Kunste Berlin (UdK) · deadline Closed 28 Aug 2026 · Two-month residency with an artist fee of EUR 1,500 per residency month. NO funds are available for travel or housing. For duos or collectives the fee remains the same and is shared. No application fee.
  • Institut francais x Cite internationale des arts Residencies 2027-2028
    https://www.institutfrancais.com/en/programme/residence-and-professional-mobility/residencies-institut-francais-x-cite-internationale
    Institut francais de Paris (with Cite internationale des arts) · deadline 08 Oct 2026 · Furnished, Wi-Fi-equipped studio apartment in Paris with monthly costs covered by the Institut francais. The nominating partner organisation must provide a residency stipend of at least EUR 1,100 per month and cover the artist's international travel, insurance (health, repatriation, liability) and any visa fees. No application fee.

Full listing with filters: The Grant Desk (https://www.artificialnouveau.com/smalltools/grants/).

item.title: 3 new Cross-disciplinary & Social Impact residencies - week of 01 Jun 2026
item.description:
• OASIS: Disappearing Landscape Residency 2026 (High Tatras, Slovakia)
    https://www.machaon.eu/en/news/disappearing-landscape-2026-open-call
    Association for Nature Conservation - Machaon International, with Kolaj 22 and Ukrainian-Slovak HUB (European OASIS project) · deadline Closed 07 Jun 2026 · Artist fee up to EUR 1,300; travel support up to EUR 300 (for international artists); production/material support up to EUR 300; accommodation and meals; access to workspaces and partner venues; organisational support and networking; public presentation opportunities; excursions in the High Tatras region. No application fee.
  • PRAKSIS: Opening Doors Nordic/Baltic Artist Residency 2026 (Oslo)
    https://on-the-move.org/news/praksis-opening-doors-nordicbaltic-artist-residency-2026-norway
    PRAKSIS (funded by the Nordic Culture Fund; Opening Doors co-funded by the European Union via Erasmus+ Youth) · deadline Closed 17 Jun 2026 · Accommodation in Oslo; shared studio space at PRAKSIS; residency stipend of EUR 1,600 per month for three months (EUR 4,800 total); travel support of EUR 350; production/materials allowance of EUR 400. No application fee.
  • Faber Andorra Residency 2027
    https://faberllull.cat/en/residencia.cfm?id=45820
    Faberllull · deadline Closed 13 Jul 2026 · EUR 60 daily meal allowance plus fully equipped apartment (free) and 30 sqm visual/performing arts workshop. Travel and medical insurance NOT covered. No application fee.
